}}'''Coram''' is an [[Aiel]] warrior.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Coram}}

== Appearance ==
He is broad-shouldered.

== Activities ==
He was in the area when bandits captured [[Nynaeve]], [[Egwene]] and [[Elayne]]. [[Aviendha]] sought him out to get help for the rescue.{{ref/book|3|39}}

He guards [[Verin Mathwin]] against anyone who might misunderstand her position in the [[Aiel]] camp.{{ref/book|8|p}}
